events.title: German-Language Volunteer Guided Tour
events.description: A guided tour of the current gallery collection conducted in German, offering a unique perspective for language learners and art enthusiasts to engage with works in a conversational setting.

events.title: Members Lecture Tintoretto's The risen Christ
events.description: An in-depth art historical analysis of Tintoretto’s masterpiece, exploring its composition, religious context, and significance within the Renaissance period.

events.title: Unfinished Business: Equality at Work? Panel Discussion
events.description: A panel discussion examining the current state of equality in professional environments, featuring academic experts discussing social structures and workplace dynamics.

events.title: Tamil-Language Volunteer Guided Tour
events.description: A volunteer-led exploration of the gallery collection conducted in Tamil, fostering community engagement and cultural discussion around the art on display.

events.title: Science Night - Amphibians with Dr Ian Brennan
events.description: An evening of scientific discovery featuring Dr Ian Brennan exploring the biology and evolution of amphibians, designed for curious minds interested in natural history.
